items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The first time I met Bumps, it was with the - not Les, (inaudible).

ctx.x: Well, you helped me get into the union, I remember that. So thanks a lot. Here's another player, too, of that period, Bumps Meyers.
Bumps Meyers? Yeah, he's dead now.
Well, yeah, he's dead, but he was a fine tenor player.
